basic_profile.bio: Based in Portland, Oregon, I am an avid tabletop role-playing game enthusiast with a particular passion for Dungeons & Dragons and its Gothic horror campaigns like Curse of Strahd. By day, I work as a software developer for a tech startup, and by night, I am a Dungeon Master crafting intricate stories for my friends. I am single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the local hiking trails or indulging in my tarantula-keeping hobby. My online hours are typically late evenings and weekends when I'm not engrossed in a new campaign or coding project.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of role-playing games, particularly Dungeons & Dragons, which I've been playing for over a decade. My expertise stems from countless hours of gameplay, extensive reading of game manuals, and active participation in RPG forums. Additionally, my background in computer science helps me in creating digital tools to enhance my campaigns.
